info.description:
# Field rep app — live routes only

Generated 2026-09-16 from `php artisan route:list`. Nothing here 404s because it was never built.

Import `docs/api/environments/rep-android.postman_environment.json`.
`baseUrl` is the **host only** (`http://127.0.0.1:8000`). Each request carries `api/v1` in its path.

OTP on staging is `000000`. Local OTP is in `storage/logs/laravel.log` as `[OTP]`.

⚠️ Postman's `{{$guid}}` regenerates per send. The Flutter client must reuse **one key per user intent**.
